$description: The owner's glass: dark blues and slate with alpha, never black ("NEVER USE BLACK USE DARKS BUT TEALS PURPLES BLUES ALL DARK DARK DARK OR SLATE"). 8-tier system from near-opaque to accent tint. Consumed by the `surface` named-preset file.

glass.$description: Glass surface fills — translucent with alpha. 8-tier system from near-opaque to transparent.

void.$description: Darkest glass — the owner's void, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.97): dark blue-slate, never black.

deep.$description: Heavy glass — the owner's deep, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.95): overlays, inputs, chat panels.

smoke.$description: Smoky glass — the owner's glass panel, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.7): raised cards, panels.

standard.$description: Default glass — the owner's pulseos panel, hsl(222 48% 11% / 0.7).

light.$description: Light glass — the owner's cyber panel, hsl(220 22% 23% / 0.7): secondary panels, toolbars.
